title: S-matrix informed neural networks for amplitude analysis
abstract: arXiv:2608.23750v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reconstructing scattering amplitudes from finite, noisy, and mutually inconsistent measurements is an ill-posed inverse problem common to many reactions relevant to particle physics. We introduce S-matrix informed neural networks (SINNs), and demonstrate their ability to learn scattering amplitudes directly from data while respecting first principles. We further develop a novel data selection procedure, which uses the response of constrained neural network ensembles to identify a set of experiments compatible with first principles, and with each other. We apply this framework to $\pi\pi$ scattering, producing reusable amplitudes and correlated uncertainties without relying on a fixed functional form. We validate our results against residual model dependencies and training biases through closure tests and ablations. We find negligible impact of model architecture on our results. translated_title: 基于S矩阵信息神经网络进行振幅分析
translated_abstract: 从有限、含噪且相互不一致的测量数据中重建散射振幅，是粒子物理中许多反应常见的病态逆问题。我们引入了S矩阵信息神经网络（SINNs），并展示了其直接从数据中学习散射振幅、同时遵循第一性原理的能力。我们还开发了一种新颖的数据选择程序，利用受约束神经网络集成的响应来识别一组与第一性原理及彼此兼容的实验。我们将此框架应用于$\pi\pi$散射，生成了可复用的振幅及相关的系统不确定性，而无需依赖固定的函数形式。我们通过闭合测试和消融实验，验证了结果对残余模型依赖性和训练偏差的稳健性。我们发现模型架构对结果的影响可忽略不计。我们的工作流程统一了物理约束下的表示方法。
tldr: 本文提出S矩阵信息神经网络（SINNs），直接从数据学习散射振幅并遵循第一性原理，同时开发了数据选择程序以识别兼容实验，成功应用于ππ散射，生成可复用振幅且不受固定函数形式限制。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces S-matrix informed neural networks (SINNs) that learn scattering amplitudes directly from data while respecting first principles, and develops a data selection procedure to identify compatible experiments, successfully applied to ππ scattering to produce reusable amplitudes without fixed functional forms.
